# SymPy capability matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/render-cas-capabilities.py; edit eval/cas_capabilities.yaml. -->

Reproducible boundary matrix for TeXada's optional CAS adapter. A successful parse in a raw LaTeX backend is a probe result, never production verification.

## Locked environment

| Component | Version | Pin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Python | >=3.12 | — |
| KaTeX | 0.17.0 | vendored |
| sympy | 1.14.0 | `==1.14.0` |
| antlr4-python3-runtime | 4.11.0 | `==4.11` |
| lark | 1.3.1 | `==1.3.1` |
| psutil | 7.2.2 | `>=6.1,<8` |

## Worker resource boundary

RSS is observed as **bytes** by `parent_pid_psutil`. `RLIMIT_AS` is not treated as the cross-platform authority. The default ceiling is **536870912 bytes**, sampled every **50 ms**. Worker startup is allowed **10000 ms** so cold SymPy imports remain reliable under CPU pressure.

| Platform | RLIMIT_AS authority | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macos | false | `cannot_lower_limit_reliably` |
| linux | false | `cross_platform_policy_uses_parent_pid_rss` |
| windows | false | `resource_module_unavailable` |

## Cache identity

The formula pair is ordered. Cache keys contain: `fingerprint_a`, `fingerprint_b`, `assumptions`, `sympy_version`, `policy_version`, `seed`.

## Acceptance red lines

- Maximum observed false verified: **0**.
- Unsupported input reaches the comparator: **false**.
- Verified requires an evidence basis: **true**.
- Verified always exposes assumptions: **true**.
- Verified always exposes the task seed: **true**.
- Verified always exposes the policy version: **true**.

The zero-false-verified threshold applies to this pinned matrix, not to all possible mathematics. Coverage may expand only by adding cases and preserving that threshold.
